attchmntText: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of the Q2 FY 2026-27 Earnings Conference Call.
voiceSummary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings conference call with BSE and NSE. The call was held on November 6, 2026, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Management discussed the integration of the TruBridge acquisition. Three of TruBridge's top five executives joined the combined entity's leadership. The company reported strong customer stickiness and access to patient records exceeding initial estimates. Management stated that margin synergy opportunities beat expectations. The firm outlined its strategy to build a system of intelligence layer using data from TruBridge and legacy IKS business. This layer aims to enable a system of action platform for workflow optimization. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of Turbo Health Holdings, LLC.
voiceSummary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited disclosed that its wholly owned US subsidiary, IKS Inc., approved the acquisition of 100% shareholding in Turbo Health Holdings LLC on November 9, 2026. The acquisition was completed on November 10, 2026, for a cash consideration of USD 500,000. The target entity is a newly incorporated healthcare technology company in the United States, established on November 5, 2026. It operates in the ambulatory revenue cycle management segment. The transaction does not constitute a related party transaction. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required. The acquisition aims to expand market reach and strengthen solutions for healthcare organizations.
